title: [DocDB] Fix compilation error maybe-uninitialized on is_something_shared
body:
### Description

On centos-gcc-fastdebug, compilation fails with

```
/-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
| COMPILATION FAILED
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.cc: In member function 'yb::Result<yb::Slice> rocksdb::Block::GetMiddleKey(rocksdb::KeyValueEncodingFormat) const':
src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.cc:113:7: error: 'is_something_shared' may be used uninitialized in this function [-Werror=maybe-uninitialized]
       if (PREDICT_FALSE(is_something_shared)) {
       ^
src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.cc:105:12: note: 'is_something_shared' was declared here
       bool is_something_shared;
            ^
In file included from src/yb/rocksdb/db/dbformat.h:43:0,
                 from src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.h:35,
                 from src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.cc:26:
src/yb/rocksdb/util/coding.h: In member function 'bool rocksdb::BlockIter::ParseNextKey()':
src/yb/rocksdb/util/coding.h:188:37: error: 'last_component' may be used uninitialized in this function [-Werror=maybe-uninitialized]
   memcpy(buf, &value, sizeof(value));
                                     ^
In file included from src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.h:35:0,
                 from src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.cc:26:
src/yb/rocksdb/db/dbformat.h:421:14: note: 'last_component' was declared here
     uint64_t last_component;
              ^
src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.cc: In member function 'bool rocksdb::BlockIter::BinarySeek(const Slice&, uint32_t, uint32_t, uint32_t*)':
src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.cc:113:7: error: 'is_something_shared' may be used uninitialized in this function [-Werror=maybe-uninitialized]
       if (PREDICT_FALSE(is_something_shared)) {
       ^
src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.cc:105:12: note: 'is_something_shared' was declared here
       bool is_something_shared;
            ^
src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.cc: In member function 'int rocksdb::BlockIter::CompareBlockKey(uint32_t, const Slice&)':
src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.cc:113:7: error: 'is_something_shared' may be used uninitialized in this function [-Werror=maybe-uninitialized]
       if (PREDICT_FALSE(is_something_shared)) {
       ^
src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.cc:105:12: note: 'is_something_shared' was declared here
       bool is_something_shared;
            ^
cc1plus: all warnings being treated as errors

Input files:
  build/fastdebug-gcc-dynamic-ninja/src/yb/rocksdb/CMakeFiles/rocksdb.dir/table/block.cc.o
  src/yb/rocksdb/table/block.cc
Output file (from -o): build/fastdebug-gcc-dynamic-ninja/src/yb/rocksdb/CMakeFiles/rocksdb.dir/table/block.cc.o
\-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

ever since commit 2e3c1fafddce25949e299d07fb12e2f4f47017b2 ([#10094] docdb: Implemented advanced delta encoding/decoding optimized for docdb-specific rocksdb keys).

This is interesting since centos-gcc-debug and centos-clang11-fastdebug compile fine.
